rows.sourceOracle: macOS BurnBarRPC newline-framed AF_UNIX contracts in OpenBurnBarDaemonServer.swift and OpenBurnBarCLI.swift
rows.acceptedDivergence: Linux uses AF_UNIX peer credentials and XDG runtime paths; it must not invent DaemonEnvelope, DaemonTransport, UnixSocketTransport, or NSXPC.
rows.promotionCriterion: Fresh daemon plus CLI lifecycle, diagnostics, subscription resume, gateway auth, socket permission, and negative-auth evidence pass from the release commit.

rows.acceptedDivergence: Linux requires the mission SQLCipher build with HAS_CODEC and ENABLE_FTS5 under /opt/openburnbar/sqlcipher.
rows.promotionCriterion: Encrypted open, wrong-key rejection, FTS5 search/vector fixtures, provider quota durability, WAL backup/restore, and schema mirror validation pass.
rows.environment: Docker Linux arm64 toolchain with SQLCipher 4.5.6 FTS5

rows.command: bash scripts/linux/build-native-ffi.sh && swift run --package-path OpenBurnBarCore ImportSmoke
rows.sourceOracle: Native Signal and iroh FFI import/link smoke plus nm/ldd inspection
rows.acceptedDivergence: Testing-only Signal facades are not production Linux symbols.
rows.promotionCriterion: Native libsignal_ffi.a and libopenburnbar_iroh.so are rebuilt from source and imported by SwiftPM on the release commit.

rows.platform: Xvfb/Openbox/XFCE plus Ayatana tray in Docker
rows.sourceOracle: Packaged desktop session with real daemon socket and route oracle
rows.acceptedDivergence: Desktop environment tray fallback is allowed only when the fallback is explicitly visible in the shell.
rows.promotionCriterion: Validator regression VAL-SHELL-001 must be cleared with real daemon proof, not fake AF_UNIX socket evidence.

rows.platform: Linux desktop session with Wayland portal/X11 fallback
rows.sourceOracle: macOS Computer Use approval and audit invariants
rows.acceptedDivergence: Wayland portal limits may be blocked only with runner evidence; X11 fallback alone is not Wayland parity.
rows.promotionCriterion: Real portal capture/input permissions, audit entries, and denial paths pass without synthetic replay.

rows.platform: Linux shell, daemon CLI, mobile remote, and system hook where available
rows.sourceOracle: macOS panic halt budget and audit-cleanup contract
rows.acceptedDivergence: Global/system hook may be blocked by OS limits; app, daemon, mobile, cleanup, and restart/reconnect paths may not be synthetic.
rows.promotionCriterion: Validator regression VAL-CU-003 must be cleared by driving real app, daemon, mobile, capture/input/media cleanup, and reconnect surfaces.
rows.environment: current benchmark uses synthetic child process kills

rows.platform: Linux iroh/media loopback plus LAN/mobile/mac interop
rows.sourceOracle: ADR-008 Mercury stage timings and media transport contracts
rows.acceptedDivergence: Loopback-only proof is not LAN/mobile/mac interop.
rows.promotionCriterion: Live codec negotiation, backpressure, media-frame-v2 traces, LAN/mobile/mac interop, and P50/P95/P99 timing pass.
rows.environment: current artifact is static model rows plus loopback

rows.promotionCriterion: Validator regression VAL-MDNS-001 must be cleared with real Avahi escaped-name and TXT parsing.

rows.acceptedDivergence: Linux uses XDG runtime paths instead of macOS app group paths.
